def register_start_handlers(bot):

    # ==============================
    # /start
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["start"])
    def start(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        continue_registration_or_main(
            bot=bot,
            chat_id=message.chat.id,
            user_id=user_id
        )

    # ==============================
    # CHARACTER NAME INPUT
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in PENDING_CHARACTER_NAME)
    def receive_character_name(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if message.text and message.text.startswith("/"):
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "ℹ️ Спочатку введи ім’я персонажа."
            )
            return

        result = set_character_name(user_id, message.text)

        if not result["success"]:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                result["message"]
            )
            return

        PENDING_CHARACTER_NAME.discard(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            result["message"]
        )

        if needs_character_class(user_id):
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_class_selection_text(user_id, mode="register"),
                reply_markup=build_class_selection_kb(mode="register")
            )
            return

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_main_menu_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    # ==============================
    # INITIAL CLASS SELECTION
    # ==============================

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("legacy_disabled_select_class:"))
    def select_class(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        class_key = call.data.split(":")[1]

        result = set_character_class(user_id, class_key)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        if not result["success"]:
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                result["message"]
            )
            return

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            (
                f"{result['message']}\n\n"
                f"Твій шлях починається."
            )
        )

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            build_main_menu_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    # ==============================
    # CLASS CHANGE BY SPHERE
    # ==============================

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("legacy_disabled_change_class:"))
    def change_class(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        class_key = call.data.split(":")[1]

        if not has_class_change_available(user_id):
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "❌ Зміна класу недоступна."
            )
            return

        old_class = get_character_class_display(user_id)

        result = set_character_class(user_id, class_key)

        if not result["success"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                result["message"]
            )
            return

        consume_result = consume_class_change_available(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        # Character System returns bool for consume_class_change_available().
        # Keep compatibility with a possible historical dict result as well.
        if isinstance(consume_result, dict):
            consume_success = bool(consume_result.get("success"))
            consume_message = consume_result.get(
                "message",
                "❌ Не вдалося використати право на зміну класу."
            )
        else:
            consume_success = bool(consume_result)
            consume_message = "❌ Не вдалося використати право на зміну класу."

        if not consume_success:
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                consume_message
            )
            return

        unequip_result = unequip_incompatible_items_after_class_change(user_id)
        unequip_text = build_class_change_unequip_text_local(unequip_result)
        new_class_name = (
            result.get("class_name")
            or get_character_class_display(user_id)
            or result.get("class_key")
            or class_key
        )

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            (
                f"🔮 Клас змінено.\n\n"
                f"Було: {old_class}\n"
                f"Стало: {new_class_name}"
                f"{unequip_text}"
            )
        )

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            build_main_menu_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

def build_class_preview_text_17_13_1(user_id, mode, class_key):
    mode = _class_mode_17_13_1(mode)
    config = CLASS_CONFIGS.get(class_key)
    if not config:
        return None
    from handlers.combat import CLASS_SKILLS_V1
    skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
    max_mp = _projected_max_mp_for_class_20_3_4a(user_id, class_key)
    text = f"{config['name']}\n\n{config['description']}\n\n✨ Навички першого рівня:\n"
    for index, skill in enumerate(skills):
        if index:
            text += "\n"
        description = str(skill.get("description") or "")
        if skill.get("cost_type") == "mana":
            from data.mana_skill_presentation import strip_legacy_mana_cost_from_description
            description = strip_legacy_mana_cost_from_description(skill)
        cost_text = _skill_cost_text_17_13_1(skill, max_mp)
        text += f"\n• {skill['name']}\n  {description}\n  {cost_text}"
        cooldown = int(skill.get("cooldown", 0) or 0)
        text += f"\n  Перезарядка: {cooldown} ход."
    if mode == "change":
        from systems.attribute_respec_system import get_attribute_respec_preview
        preview = get_attribute_respec_preview(user_id)
        text += (
            f"\n\n♻️ Буде повернено очок характеристик: {preview['returned_points']}"
            "\n⚠️ Поточний розподіл характеристик буде скинуто."
            "\n🎒 Сфера нового шляху буде витрачена лише після підтвердження."
        )
    return text

    `db.get_player_stats` currently returns the six-value tuple
    `(STR, DEX, INT, WIS, STA, level)`. Older tests and integrations may supply
    mappings or row-like objects, so the adapter preserves the value unchanged.
    Story-boss presentation does not derive location from this value.
    """
    getter = getattr(db, "get_player_stats", None)
    return getter(user_id) if callable(getter) else None

def _presentation_for_user(user_id: int):
    stats = _player_stats(user_id)
    location_id = _location_id(user_id, stats)
    call = _active_call(user_id, location_id)
    # Eligibility denials are non-empty dictionaries. Render only the explicit
    # canonical allow contract; all missing/false/non-boolean values fail closed.
    if not call or _value(call, "allowed", default=False) is not True:
        return None
    from systems.story_boss_invocation_adapter import StoryBossInvocationState
    current = int(_value(call, "progress_current", "current", "progress", default=0) or 0)
    target = int(_value(call, "progress_target", "target", "target_quantity", default=1) or 1)
    quest_number = int(_value(call, "quest_number", "number", default=49) or 49)
    status = str(_value(call, "quest_status", "status", default="ACTIVE") or "ACTIVE")
    state = StoryBossInvocationState(
        quest_number=quest_number,
        quest_status=status,
        progress_current=current,
        progress_target=target,
        expected_location_id=str(_value(call, "location_id", "expected_location_id", default="start_path") or "start_path"),
        current_location_id=location_id,
        has_active_encounter=False,
        has_active_travel=False,
        is_busy=False,
    )
    return build_story_boss_look_around_presentation(state)

def _active_story_boss_callback_call(user_id: int, expected_quest_number: int):
    """Return an ACTIVE production BOSS quest without applying an invoke location gate.

    HELP is intentionally available from the city NPC, while the actual INVOKE
    branch still calls `_presentation_for_user`, which revalidates the current
    quest location, progress, travel and encounter state before combat starts.
    """
    from data.story_quest_content import STORY_QUEST_REGISTRY
    from data.story_quest_definitions import QuestType
    from db_modules.story_quests import get_active_story_quest

    active = get_active_story_quest(db.conn, int(user_id))
    if active is None:
        return None
    quest = STORY_QUEST_REGISTRY.get(str(active["quest_id"]))
    if quest is None or quest.quest_type is not QuestType.BOSS:
        return None
    if int(quest.number) != int(expected_quest_number):
        return None
    if str(active["status"]).upper() != "ACTIVE":
        return None
    return {
        "allowed": True,
        "quest_id": quest.quest_id,
        "quest_number": quest.number,
        "quest_status": str(active["status"]),
        "progress_current": int(active["progress"]),
        "progress_target": int(active["target_quantity"]),
        "boss_key": quest.boss_key,
        "location_id": quest.location_id,
    }

def _edit_story_journal_safely(bot, *, chat_id, message_id, text, reply_markup):
    """Edit the journal while treating Telegram's identical-content 400 as success.

    Refresh may legitimately reproduce the same text and keyboard. Telegram
    rejects that no-op edit with HTTP 400, but the journal is already current.
    Only that exact condition is suppressed; every unrelated API error remains
    visible to the polling/recovery layer.
    """
    from telebot.apihelper import ApiTelegramException

    try:
        bot.edit_message_text(
            text,
            chat_id,
            message_id,
            reply_markup=reply_markup,
        )
        return True
    except ApiTelegramException as error:
        description = str(error).casefold()
        if "message is not modified" in description:
            return False
        raise

def build_production_story_quest_detail(connection, *, user_id: int, quest_id: str, player_level: int, page: int = 0) -> dict:
    """Render one canonical definition plus current lifecycle state.

    Acceptance remains NPC-owned. The journal only explains the objective,
    route, progress, reward, and unlock prerequisites.
    """
    import db
    from data.story_quest_content import STORY_QUEST_REGISTRY
    from data.story_quest_npcs import resolve_story_quest_navigation
    from systems.story_quest_system import get_story_quest_view
    try:
        quest = STORY_QUEST_REGISTRY[str(quest_id)]
    except KeyError as error:
        raise StoryQuestUiError(f"unknown production story quest: {quest_id}") from error
    view = get_story_quest_view(connection, user_id=int(user_id), quest=quest, player_level=int(player_level))
    status = str(view["status"])
    progress = max(int(view.get("progress",0)), int(view.get("quest_item_quantity",0)))
    from data.story_quest_title_presentation import resolve_story_quest_presentation_title
    presentation_title = resolve_story_quest_presentation_title(quest, status, int(view.get("quest_item_quantity", 0)))
    lines = [f"📜 {quest.number}. {presentation_title}", "", f"Статус: {_status_label(status)}", "", "📖 Опис:", quest.description, "", "🎯 Завдання:", quest.objective_text]
    if _should_show_story_quest_progress(status, quest):
        lines += ["", "📈 Прогрес:", f"{min(progress,quest.target_quantity)}/{quest.target_quantity}"]
    if status == "ACTIVE" and quest.quest_type is QuestType.BOSS and progress >= int(quest.target_quantity):
        lines += [
            "",
            "✅ Ватажка переможено.",
            "Повернися до Голови Найманців із доповіддю.",
        ]
    if status == "ACTIVE" and quest.quest_type is QuestType.QUEST_ITEM and quest.quest_item is not None:
        if progress >= int(quest.quest_item.required_quantity):
            lines += ["", "✅ Знахідку отримано:", quest.quest_item.display_name]
        else:
            lines += ["", "🔎 Стан пошуку:", "Доказ ще не знайдено."]
    if status == "LOCKED":
        lines += ["", "🔒 Для відкриття:"]
        if quest.previous_quest_id:
            previous = STORY_QUEST_REGISTRY.get(quest.previous_quest_id)
            lines.append(f"• завершити квест {previous.number if previous else '?'} «{previous.title if previous else quest.previous_quest_id}»")
        lines.append(f"• досягти {quest.unlock_level} рівня")
    journal_navigation = resolve_story_quest_journal_navigation(quest, status, progress)
    if journal_navigation is not None:
        route_label, route_text = journal_navigation
        lines += ["", route_label, route_text]
    lines += ["", "🎁 Нагорода:", f"{quest.reward.exp} EXP", f"{float(quest.reward.gold):.2f} золота"]
    return {"text":"\n".join(lines),"keyboard":build_story_quest_detail_keyboard(quest_id=quest.quest_id,status=status,page=page)}

def up(conn):
    missing = sorted(REQUIRED_COLUMNS - _columns(conn))
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Migration 043 missing required columns: {missing}")
    timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    rows = conn.execute("""SELECT user_id, COALESCE(level,1),
        COALESCE(free_attribute_points,0), COALESCE(total_attribute_points_earned,0),
        COALESCE(allocated_strength,0), COALESCE(allocated_dexterity,0),
        COALESCE(allocated_intelligence,0), COALESCE(allocated_wisdom,0),
        COALESCE(allocated_stamina,0)
        FROM users WHERE attribute_points_migrated_at IS NULL
           OR TRIM(attribute_points_migrated_at)='' ORDER BY user_id""").fetchall()
    migrated = compensated = excess = 0
    points_added = 0
    for row in rows:
        user_id, level, free_points, earned, a_str, a_dex, a_int, a_wis, a_sta = map(int, row)
        allocated = a_str + a_dex + a_int + a_wis + a_sta
        if earned != free_points + allocated:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Migration 043 invariant failed before migration for user {user_id}: "
                f"earned={earned}, free={free_points}, allocated={allocated}"
            )
        expected_total = max(0, level - 1) * POINTS_PER_LEVEL
        missing_points = max(0, expected_total - earned)
        if earned > expected_total:
            excess += 1
        if missing_points:
            compensated += 1
            points_added += missing_points
        conn.execute("""UPDATE users SET
            free_attribute_points=free_attribute_points+?,
            total_attribute_points_earned=total_attribute_points_earned+?,
            attribute_points_migrated_at=?
            WHERE user_id=? AND (attribute_points_migrated_at IS NULL
                OR TRIM(attribute_points_migrated_at)='')""",
            (missing_points, missing_points, timestamp, user_id),
        )
        if conn.execute("SELECT changes()").fetchone()[0] != 1:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Migration 043 concurrent/idempotency update failed for user {user_id}")
        migrated += 1
    invalid = conn.execute("""SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE
        total_attribute_points_earned != free_attribute_points
          + allocated_strength + allocated_dexterity + allocated_intelligence
          + allocated_wisdom + allocated_stamina""").fetchone()[0]
    if invalid:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Migration 043 post-invariant violations: {invalid}")
    unmarked = conn.execute("""SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE
        attribute_points_migrated_at IS NULL OR TRIM(attribute_points_migrated_at)=''""").fetchone()[0]
    if unmarked:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Migration 043 unmarked users after migration: {unmarked}")
    return {"migrated":migrated,"compensated":compensated,
            "points_added":points_added,"excess_preserved":excess}

            slot_key=excluded.slot_key,
            weapon_hands=excluded.weapon_hands,

def up(conn):
    """Create story-quest persistence using the runner-owned connection.

    The migration intentionally does not commit. Transaction ownership belongs
    to the canonical migration runner, which can atomically commit or roll back
    the complete migration and record it in schema_migrations.
    """

    # One row represents one started or finalized quest. The partial unique
    # index enforces the policy of one ACTIVE story quest per user.
    conn.execute(
        """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_story_quests (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            quest_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            quest_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (quest_number > 0),
            status TEXT NOT NULL
                CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED', 'SKIPPED')),
            progress INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (progress >= 0),
            target_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
                CHECK (target_quantity > 0),
            reward_claimed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
                CHECK (reward_claimed IN (0, 1)),
            started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            completed_at TEXT,
            skipped_at TEXT,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE (user_id, quest_id),
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
        )
        """
    )
    conn.execute(
        """
        CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_user_story_quests_one_active
        ON user_story_quests(user_id)
        WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
        """
    )
    conn.execute(
        """
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_user_story_quests_journal
        ON user_story_quests(user_id, quest_number, status)
        """
    )

    # Quest-item rows have no inventory_id. This structural separation prevents
    # them from entering bag-capacity, vendor, auction or player-trade routes.
    conn.execute(
        """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_story_quest_items (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
            quest_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            item_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (quantity >= 0),
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            UNIQUE (user_id, quest_id, item_key),
            FOREIGN KEY (user_id, quest_id)
                REFERENCES user_story_quests(user_id, quest_id)
                ON DELETE CASCADE
        )
        """
    )
    conn.execute(
        """
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_user_story_quest_items_owner
        ON user_story_quest_items(user_id, quest_id)
        """
    )

def run_pending_migrations(conn: sqlite3.Connection, migrations_dir: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    """Run pending migrations. Returns a diagnostics dict."""

    ensure_migrations_table(conn)
    applied = get_applied_migrations(conn)
    files = discover_migration_files(migrations_dir)

    result = {
        "success": True,
        "applied": [],
        "skipped": [],
        "failed": None,
        "total_files": len(files),
    }

    for path in files:
        migration_name = path.name

        if migration_name in applied:
            result["skipped"].append(migration_name)
            continue

        try:
            migration_func = load_migration_callable(path)
            migration_func(conn)
            conn.commit()
            mark_migration_applied(conn, migration_name)
            result["applied"].append(migration_name)
        except Exception as error:
            conn.rollback()
            result["success"] = False
            result["failed"] = {
                "migration": migration_name,
                "error": str(error),
            }
            raise

    return result

def _state_from_row(user_id: int, row) -> AttributePointState:
    if row is None:
        raise PlayerNotFoundError(f"Player not found: {user_id}")
    names = (
        "free_attribute_points",
        "total_attribute_points_earned",
        "allocated_strength",
        "allocated_dexterity",
        "allocated_intelligence",
        "allocated_wisdom",
        "allocated_stamina",
    )
    values = [_row_value(row, name, index) for index, name in enumerate(names)]
    state = AttributePointState(int(user_id), *values)
    _validate_state(state)
    return state

def allocate_attribute_points(
    user_id: int,
    allocation: Mapping[str, int],
    *,
    expected_free_attribute_points: int | None = None,
    db_module=None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Atomically allocate points and return before/after state.

    `expected_free_attribute_points` is an optimistic concurrency token for UI
    confirmation. A repeated or stale confirmation fails instead of spending a
    newer balance.
    """
    normalized = normalize_allocation(allocation)
    spent = sum(normalized.values())
    database = _db_module(db_module)
    connection = database.conn
    cursor = database.cursor

    if connection.in_transaction:
        raise AttributeAllocationError(
            "allocate_attribute_points requires ownership of its transaction"
        )

    connection.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
    try:
        before = _fetch_state(cursor, int(user_id))
        if expected_free_attribute_points is not None:
            if isinstance(expected_free_attribute_points, bool) or not isinstance(
                expected_free_attribute_points, int
            ):
                raise InvalidAllocationError(
                    "expected_free_attribute_points must be an integer or None"
                )
            if before.free_attribute_points != expected_free_attribute_points:
                raise StaleAttributeStateError(
                    "Attribute point balance changed; refresh before confirming"
                )
        if spent > before.free_attribute_points:
            raise InsufficientAttributePointsError(
                f"Not enough free attribute points: required={spent}, "
                f"available={before.free_attribute_points}"
            )

        cursor.execute(
            """UPDATE users SET
                   free_attribute_points = free_attribute_points - ?,
                   allocated_strength = allocated_strength + ?,
                   allocated_dexterity = allocated_dexterity + ?,
                   allocated_intelligence = allocated_intelligence + ?,
                   allocated_wisdom = allocated_wisdom + ?,
                   allocated_stamina = allocated_stamina + ?
                 WHERE user_id=? AND free_attribute_points >= ?""",
            (
                spent,
                normalized["strength"],
                normalized["dexterity"],
                normalized["intelligence"],
                normalized["wisdom"],
                normalized["stamina"],
                int(user_id),
                spent,
            ),
        )
        if cursor.rowcount != 1:
            raise StaleAttributeStateError(
                "Attribute point state changed during confirmation"
            )
        after = _fetch_state(cursor, int(user_id))
        if after.total_attribute_points_earned != before.total_attribute_points_earned:
            raise AttributeInvariantError("Allocation cannot change total earned points")
        connection.commit()
    except Exception:
        connection.rollback()
        raise

    return {
        "user_id": int(user_id),
        "spent": spent,
        "allocation": normalized,
        "before": before.to_dict(),
        "after": after.to_dict(),
    }

def normalize_auction_category(category):
    category = str(category or "").strip().lower()

    aliases = {
        "⚔️ спорядження": AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
        "спорядження": AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
        "equipment": AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
        "gear": AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
        "🧪 зілля": AUCTION_CATEGORY_POTION,
        "зілля": AUCTION_CATEGORY_POTION,
        "potion": AUCTION_CATEGORY_POTION,
        "potions": AUCTION_CATEGORY_POTION,
        "🪨 матеріали": AUCTION_CATEGORY_MATERIAL,
        "матеріали": AUCTION_CATEGORY_MATERIAL,
        "material": AUCTION_CATEGORY_MATERIAL,
        "materials": AUCTION_CATEGORY_MATERIAL,
    }

    category = aliases.get(category, category)

    if category not in AUCTION_ALLOWED_CATEGORIES:
        raise ValueError("Некоректна категорія Торгового Дому.")

    return category

        seller_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        buyer_user_id INTEGER,

        item_type TEXT NOT NULL,

        price TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',

        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,

        sold_at TEXT,

        delete_after TEXT,

def create_auction_lot_record(
    seller_user_id,
    item_type,
    item_snapshot,
    item_name,
    category,
    price,
    quantity=1,
    item_source="",
    item_ref_id=None,
    rarity="",
    level=0,
    enhancement_level=0,
    durability_current=None,
    durability_max=None,
):
    """
    Creates only the auction lot record.

    IMPORTANT:
    This helper does not remove or lock the item from inventory yet.
    Item movement/locking will be implemented in later patches.
    """

    init_auction_house()

    can_create = can_user_create_auction_lot(seller_user_id)
    if not can_create.get("success"):
        return can_create

    price_result = validate_auction_price(price)
    if not price_result.get("success"):
        return price_result

    category = normalize_auction_category(category)

    try:
        quantity = int(quantity or 1)
    except Exception:
        quantity = 1

    if quantity <= 0:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Кількість має бути більшою за 0.",
        }

    item_name = str(item_name or "").strip()
    if not item_name:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Назва предмета не може бути порожньою.",
        }

    now = now_iso()
    expires_at = iso_after_days(AUCTION_ACTIVE_DAYS)

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO auction_lots (
        seller_user_id,
        buyer_user_id,
        item_type,
        item_source,
        item_ref_id,
        item_snapshot_json,
        item_name,
        item_name_norm,
        category,
        rarity,
        level,
        enhancement_level,
        durability_current,
        durability_max,
        quantity,
        price,
        status,
        created_at,
        expires_at,
        updated_at
    ) VALUES (?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        seller_user_id,
        str(item_type or ""),
        str(item_source or ""),
        item_ref_id,
        safe_json_dumps(item_snapshot or {}),
        item_name,
        item_name.lower(),
        category,
        str(rarity or ""),
        int(level or 0),
        int(enhancement_level or 0),
        durability_current,
        durability_max,
        quantity,
        price_result["price"],
        AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        now,
        expires_at,
        now,
    ))

    lot_id = cursor.lastrowid
    conn.commit()

    add_auction_history(
        lot_id=lot_id,
        event_type=AUCTION_HISTORY_LISTED,
        actor_user_id=seller_user_id,
        seller_user_id=seller_user_id,
        item_name=item_name,
        category=category,
        quantity=quantity,
        price=price_result["price"],
        status_before=None,
        status_after=AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        details={"item_type": item_type, "item_source": item_source, "item_ref_id": item_ref_id},
    )

    return {
        "success": True,
        "lot_id": lot_id,
        "message": "✅ Лот створено.",
    }

def mark_auction_lot_status(lot_id, status_after, actor_user_id=None, event_type=None, details=None):
    init_auction_house()

    lot = get_auction_lot_by_id(lot_id)
    if not lot:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Лот не знайдено.",
        }

    status_before = lot["status"]
    now = now_iso()

    delete_after = lot["delete_after"]
    claimed_at = lot["claimed_at"]

    if status_after in [AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED, AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED]:
        delete_after = iso_after_days(AUCTION_CLAIM_DAYS)

    if status_after in [AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_CLAIMED, AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_CLAIMED]:
        claimed_at = now

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE auction_lots
    SET status=?,
        claimed_at=?,
        delete_after=?,
        updated_at=?
    WHERE id=?
    """, (
        status_after,
        claimed_at,
        delete_after,
        now,
        lot_id,
    ))
    conn.commit()

    add_auction_history(
        lot_id=lot_id,
        event_type=event_type or status_after,
        actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
        seller_user_id=lot["seller_user_id"],
        buyer_user_id=lot["buyer_user_id"],
        item_name=lot["item_name"],
        category=lot["category"],
        quantity=lot["quantity"],
        price=lot["price"],
        status_before=status_before,
        status_after=status_after,
        details=details or {},
    )

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": "✅ Статус лота оновлено.",
    }

def update_expired_auction_lots():
    """
    Expiration cleanup:
    - ACTIVE after 7 days -> EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED
    - EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED after 30 days -> DELETED
    - SOLD_UNCLAIMED after 30 days -> DELETED

    No automatic item/gold return is performed here.
    """

    init_auction_house()
    now = now_iso()

    expired_count = 0
    deleted_count = 0

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT *
    FROM auction_lots
    WHERE status=? AND expires_at<=?
    """, (
        AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        now,
    ))
    active_rows = cursor.fetchall()

    for lot in active_rows:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE auction_lots
        SET status=?,
            delete_after=?,
            updated_at=?
        WHERE id=? AND status=?
        """, (
            AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED,
            iso_after_days(AUCTION_CLAIM_DAYS),
            now,
            lot["id"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        ))

        if cursor.rowcount:
            expired_count += 1
            add_auction_history(
                lot_id=lot["id"],
                event_type=AUCTION_HISTORY_EXPIRED,
                seller_user_id=lot["seller_user_id"],
                buyer_user_id=lot["buyer_user_id"],
                item_name=lot["item_name"],
                category=lot["category"],
                quantity=lot["quantity"],
                price=lot["price"],
                status_before=AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
                status_after=AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED,
            )

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT *
    FROM auction_lots
    WHERE status IN (?, ?) AND delete_after IS NOT NULL AND delete_after<=?
    """, (
        AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED,
        AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED,
        now,
    ))
    delete_rows = cursor.fetchall()

    for lot in delete_rows:
        before = lot["status"]
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE auction_lots
        SET status=?, updated_at=?
        WHERE id=? AND status=?
        """, (
            AUCTION_STATUS_DELETED,
            now,
            lot["id"],
            before,
        ))

        if cursor.rowcount:
            deleted_count += 1
            add_auction_history(
                lot_id=lot["id"],
                event_type=AUCTION_HISTORY_DELETED,
                seller_user_id=lot["seller_user_id"],
                buyer_user_id=lot["buyer_user_id"],
                item_name=lot["item_name"],
                category=lot["category"],
                quantity=lot["quantity"],
                price=lot["price"],
                status_before=before,
                status_after=AUCTION_STATUS_DELETED,
            )

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "expired": expired_count,
        "deleted": deleted_count,
    }

def _auction_snapshot_inserted_runes(inventory_id):
    """Read inserted rune sockets before the inventory row is removed."""
    if not _auction_has_table("inventory_runes"):
        return []
    rows = cursor.execute(
        """
        SELECT ir.slot_index, ir.rune_item_id, ir.rune_stat, ir.rune_level,
               ir.inserted_at, COALESCE(it.name, '')
        FROM inventory_runes AS ir
        LEFT JOIN items AS it ON it.id = ir.rune_item_id
        WHERE ir.inventory_id=?
        ORDER BY ir.slot_index ASC, ir.id ASC
        """,
        (int(inventory_id),),
    ).fetchall()
    return [
        {
            "slot_index": int(row[0]),
            "rune_item_id": int(row[1]),
            "rune_stat": str(row[2] or "").upper(),
            "rune_level": int(row[3]),
            "inserted_at": str(row[4] or ""),
            "rune_name": str(row[5] or ""),
        }
        for row in rows
    ]

def _auction_restore_inserted_runes(inventory_id, snapshot):
    """Restore snapshotted sockets on the newly created inventory row."""
    runes = snapshot.get("inserted_runes") if isinstance(snapshot, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(runes, list) or not runes:
        return 0
    if not _auction_has_table("inventory_runes"):
        raise RuntimeError("inventory_runes table is missing")
    restored = 0
    seen = set()
    for rune in runes:
        slot_index = int(rune["slot_index"])
        if slot_index in seen:
            raise RuntimeError("duplicate rune slot in auction snapshot")
        seen.add(slot_index)
        cursor.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO inventory_runes (
                inventory_id, slot_index, rune_item_id,
                rune_stat, rune_level, inserted_at
            ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            (
                int(inventory_id), slot_index, int(rune["rune_item_id"]),
                str(rune["rune_stat"]), int(rune["rune_level"]),
                str(rune.get("inserted_at") or ""),
            ),
        )
        restored += 1
    return restored

def get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction(user_id, inventory_id):
    """
    Builds a full enough snapshot of an inventory item for Auction House listing.
    Does not mutate inventory.
    """

    row = _auction_get_inventory_row(inventory_id=inventory_id, user_id=user_id)

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Предмет не знайдено в інвентарі.",
        }

    data = _auction_row_to_dict(row)

    item_id = _auction_get_int(data, "item_id", "inventory_item_id")
    quantity = _auction_get_int(data, "inventory_quantity", "quantity", default=1)
    refine_level = _auction_get_int(data, "inventory_refine_level", "refine_level", default=0)
    raw_name = _auction_get_str(data, "item_name", "name", default="Предмет")
    display_name = _auction_format_refined_name(raw_name, refine_level)

    durability_current, durability_max = _auction_get_durability(data)

    rarity = _auction_get_str(data, "item_rarity", "rarity", default="")
    level = _auction_get_int(data, "item_level", "level", default=0)
    slot_key = _auction_get_str(data, "item_slot_key", "slot_key", default="")
    item_type = _auction_get_str(data, "item_type", "type", default="")
    item_category = _auction_get_str(data, "item_category", "category", default="")
    armor_type = _auction_get_str(data, "armor_type", "item_armor_type", default="")
    item_subtype = _auction_get_str(data, "item_subtype", "item_item_subtype", default="")
    inserted_runes = _auction_snapshot_inserted_runes(inventory_id)

    snapshot = {
        "inventory_id": int(inventory_id),
        "item_id": item_id,
        "quantity": quantity,
        "refine_level": refine_level,
        "name": display_name,
        "raw_name": raw_name,
        "rarity": rarity,
        "level": level,
        "slot_key": slot_key,
        "item_type": item_type,
        "item_category": item_category,
        "armor_type": armor_type,
        "item_subtype": item_subtype,
        "inserted_runes": inserted_runes,
        "durability_current": durability_current,
        "durability_max": durability_max,
        "row": data,
    }

    return {
        "success": True,
        "snapshot": snapshot,
    }

def get_user_sellable_equipment_for_auction(user_id, limit=50, offset=0):
    init_auction_house()

    try:
        limit = int(limit)
    except Exception:
        limit = 50
    try:
        offset = int(offset)
    except Exception:
        offset = 0

    # Fetch a wider slice and filter in Python because schemas vary across project patches.
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT inv.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN items it ON inv.item_id = it.id
    WHERE inv.user_id=?
    ORDER BY inv.id DESC
    LIMIT 200
    """, (user_id,))

    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    result = []

    for row in rows:
        try:
            inventory_id = row["inventory_id"]
        except Exception:
            inventory_id = row[0]

        check = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)

        if check.get("success"):
            snapshot = check["snapshot"]
            result.append({
                "inventory_id": inventory_id,
                "name": snapshot["name"],
                "quantity": snapshot["quantity"],
                "rarity": snapshot["rarity"],
                "level": snapshot["level"],
                "refine_level": snapshot["refine_level"],
                "durability_current": snapshot["durability_current"],
                "durability_max": snapshot["durability_max"],
                "slot_key": snapshot["slot_key"],
            })

    return result[offset:offset + limit]

def create_equipment_auction_lot(user_id, inventory_id, price):
    """
    Creates an ACTIVE auction lot from a single equipment inventory item and removes it from inventory.

    This is the first real item-listing implementation for Auction House 8.0.3.
    Stackable items/materials are intentionally handled later.
    """

    init_auction_house()

    check = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)

    if not check.get("success"):
        return check

    can_create = can_user_create_auction_lot(user_id)
    if not can_create.get("success"):
        return can_create

    price_result = validate_auction_price(price)
    if not price_result.get("success"):
        return price_result

    snapshot = check["snapshot"]
    now = now_iso()
    expires_at = iso_after_days(AUCTION_ACTIVE_DAYS)

    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        # Re-check ownership and active status inside transaction.
        check_inside = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)
        if not check_inside.get("success"):
            conn.rollback()
            return check_inside

        snapshot = check_inside["snapshot"]

        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO auction_lots (
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            item_type,
            item_source,
            item_ref_id,
            item_snapshot_json,
            item_name,
            item_name_norm,
            category,
            rarity,
            level,
            enhancement_level,
            durability_current,
            durability_max,
            quantity,
            price,
            status,
            created_at,
            expires_at,
            updated_at
        ) VALUES (?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            user_id,
            snapshot.get("item_type") or "equipment",
            "inventory",
            int(inventory_id),
            safe_json_dumps(snapshot),
            snapshot["name"],
            snapshot["name"].lower(),
            AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
            snapshot.get("rarity", ""),
            int(snapshot.get("level", 0) or 0),
            int(snapshot.get("refine_level", 0) or 0),
            snapshot.get("durability_current"),
            snapshot.get("durability_max"),
            1,
            price_result["price"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            now,
            expires_at,
            now,
        ))

        lot_id = cursor.lastrowid

        cursor.execute(
            "DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",
            (inventory_id, user_id)
        )

        if cursor.rowcount != 1:
            conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "❌ Не вдалося перенести предмет з інвентаря.",
            }

        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO auction_history (
            lot_id,
            event_type,
            actor_user_id,
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            item_name,
            category,
            quantity,
            price,
            status_before,
            status_after,
            details_json,
            created_at
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            lot_id,
            AUCTION_HISTORY_LISTED,
            user_id,
            user_id,
            snapshot["name"],
            AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
            1,
            price_result["price"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            safe_json_dumps({"inventory_id": inventory_id, "item_id": snapshot.get("item_id")}),
            now,
        ))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "success": True,
            "lot_id": lot_id,
            "item_name": snapshot["name"],
            "price": price_result["price"],
            "expires_at": expires_at,
            "message": "✅ Лот виставлено на продаж.",
        }

    except Exception as error:
        try:
            conn.rollback()
        except Exception:
            pass

        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": f"❌ Помилка створення лота: {error}",
        }

def _auction_get_inventory_row(inventory_id, user_id=None):
    """
    Schema-safe inventory + item loader.

    Older 8.0.3 code expected items.level, but this project stores item level under
    another column name in the current DB. This loader checks actual table columns
    and only selects columns that really exist.
    """

    init_auction_house()

    inventory_id = int(inventory_id)

    inv_cols = _auction_table_columns("inventory")
    item_cols = _auction_table_columns("items")

    select_parts = []

    # Stable aliases used by auction snapshot code.
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("inv", inv_cols, ["id"], "inventory_id", 0))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("inv", inv_cols, ["user_id"], "inventory_user_id", 0))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("inv", inv_cols, ["item_id"], "inventory_item_id", 0))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("inv", inv_cols, ["quantity"], "inventory_quantity", 1))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("inv", inv_cols, ["refine_level"], "inventory_refine_level", 0))

    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["id"], "item_id", 0))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["name"], "item_name", "Предмет"))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["type", "item_type"], "item_type", ""))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["category", "item_category"], "item_category", ""))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["slot_key", "slot", "equipment_slot"], "item_slot_key", ""))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["rarity", "item_rarity"], "item_rarity", ""))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["level", "item_level", "required_level", "min_level"], "item_level", 0))

    # Preserve full row details with prefixed aliases to avoid duplicate-column collisions.
    for column_name in inv_cols:
        select_parts.append(f"inv.{column_name} AS inv_{column_name}")

    for column_name in item_cols:
        select_parts.append(f"it.{column_name} AS item_{column_name}")

    sql = f"""
    SELECT
        {', '.join(select_parts)}
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN items it ON inv.item_id = it.id
    WHERE inv.id=?
    """

    params = [inventory_id]

    if user_id is not None:
        sql += " AND inv.user_id=?"
        params.append(user_id)

    cursor.execute(sql, tuple(params))
    return cursor.fetchone()

def create_stack_auction_lot(user_id, inventory_id, category, quantity, price):
    """
    Creates ACTIVE auction lot from a stackable item.

    If quantity equals the whole inventory stack, the row is deleted.
    If quantity is smaller, the inventory row quantity is reduced.
    """

    init_auction_house()

    category = normalize_auction_category(category)

    validation = validate_inventory_stack_item_for_auction(user_id, inventory_id, category, quantity)
    if not validation.get("success"):
        return validation

    can_create = can_user_create_auction_lot(user_id)
    if not can_create.get("success"):
        return can_create

    price_result = validate_auction_price(price)
    if not price_result.get("success"):
        return price_result

    snapshot = validation["snapshot"]
    quantity = int(snapshot.get("auction_quantity", quantity) or quantity)
    owned_quantity = int(snapshot.get("owned_quantity", snapshot.get("quantity", 0)) or 0)

    now = now_iso()
    expires_at = iso_after_days(AUCTION_ACTIVE_DAYS)

    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        # Re-check inside transaction.
        validation_inside = validate_inventory_stack_item_for_auction(user_id, inventory_id, category, quantity)
        if not validation_inside.get("success"):
            conn.rollback()
            return validation_inside

        snapshot = validation_inside["snapshot"]
        owned_quantity = int(snapshot.get("owned_quantity", snapshot.get("quantity", 0)) or 0)
        quantity = int(snapshot.get("auction_quantity", quantity) or quantity)

        snapshot_for_lot = dict(snapshot)
        snapshot_for_lot["quantity"] = quantity
        snapshot_for_lot["auction_quantity"] = quantity
        snapshot_for_lot["owned_quantity_before_listing"] = owned_quantity

        item_name = snapshot_for_lot["name"]
        if quantity > 1:
            item_name = f"{item_name} ×{quantity}"

        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO auction_lots (
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            item_type,
            item_source,
            item_ref_id,
            item_snapshot_json,
            item_name,
            item_name_norm,
            category,
            rarity,
            level,
            enhancement_level,
            durability_current,
            durability_max,
            quantity,
            price,
            status,
            created_at,
            expires_at,
            updated_at
        ) VALUES (?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            user_id,
            snapshot_for_lot.get("item_type") or category,
            "inventory_stack",
            int(inventory_id),
            safe_json_dumps(snapshot_for_lot),
            item_name,
            item_name.lower(),
            category,
            snapshot_for_lot.get("rarity", ""),
            0,
            0,
            None,
            None,
            quantity,
            price_result["price"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            now,
            expires_at,
            now,
        ))

        lot_id = cursor.lastrowid

        if quantity >= owned_quantity:
            cursor.execute(
                "DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",
                (inventory_id, user_id)
            )
        else:
            cursor.execute(
                "UPDATE inventory SET quantity = quantity - ? WHERE id=? AND user_id=? AND quantity>=?",
                (quantity, inventory_id, user_id, quantity)
            )

        if cursor.rowcount != 1:
            conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "❌ Не вдалося перенести кількість предметів з інвентаря.",
            }

        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO auction_history (
            lot_id,
            event_type,
            actor_user_id,
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            item_name,
            category,
            quantity,
            price,
            status_before,
            status_after,
            details_json,
            created_at
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            lot_id,
            AUCTION_HISTORY_LISTED,
            user_id,
            user_id,
            item_name,
            category,
            quantity,
            price_result["price"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            safe_json_dumps({
                "inventory_id": inventory_id,
                "item_id": snapshot_for_lot.get("item_id"),
                "owned_quantity_before_listing": owned_quantity,
            }),
            now,
        ))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "success": True,
            "lot_id": lot_id,
            "item_name": item_name,
            "quantity": quantity,
            "price": price_result["price"],
            "expires_at": expires_at,
            "message": "✅ Лот виставлено на продаж.",
        }

    except Exception as error:
        try:
            conn.rollback()
        except Exception:
            pass

        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": f"❌ Помилка створення лота: {error}",
        }

def buy_auction_lot(buyer_user_id, lot_id):
    """
    Transactional purchase.

    Checks:
    - lot exists and ACTIVE;
    - buyer is not seller;
    - buyer has enough gold;
    - buyer has inventory space or stack can be merged;
    - status update is guarded with WHERE status='ACTIVE'.
    """

    init_auction_house()
    lot_id = int(lot_id)
    buyer_user_id = int(buyer_user_id)

    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM auction_lots WHERE id=?", (lot_id,))
        lot = cursor.fetchone()

        if not lot:
            conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "❌ Лот не знайдено.",
            }

        if lot["status"] != AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE:
            conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "⚠️ Лот уже продано або він недоступний.",
            }

        seller_user_id = int(lot["seller_user_id"])
        if seller_user_id == buyer_user_id:
            conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "❌ Не можна купити власний лот.",
            }

        price = auction_price_to_decimal(lot["price"])
        buyer_gold = _auction_get_user_gold(buyer_user_id)

        if buyer_gold < price:
            conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": f"❌ Недостатньо золота. Потрібно: {lot['price']}.",
            }

        snapshot = safe_json_loads(lot["item_snapshot_json"])
        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)

        # Inventory space check before money/status changes.
        is_stack = lot["category"] in [AUCTION_CATEGORY_MATERIAL, AUCTION_CATEGORY_POTION]
        item_id = int(snapshot.get("item_id", 0) or 0)
        if is_stack and item_id > 0:
            existing_stack = _auction_get_existing_stack_inventory_id(buyer_user_id, item_id)
            needs_slot = existing_stack is None
        else:
            needs_slot = True

        if needs_slot and not _auction_has_inventory_space(buyer_user_id, 1):
            conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "⚠️ Недостатньо місця в інвентарі.",
            }

        now = now_iso()
        delete_after = iso_after_days(AUCTION_CLAIM_DAYS)

        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE auction_lots
        SET status=?,
            buyer_user_id=?,
            sold_at=?,
            delete_after=?,
            updated_at=?
        WHERE id=? AND status=?
        """, (
            AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED,
            buyer_user_id,
            now,
            delete_after,
            now,
            lot_id,

        cursor.execute("""

            "lot_id": lot_id,
            "item_name": lot["item_name"],
            "price": lot["price"],

    except Exception as error:

def _auction_enrich_equipment_snapshot_with_runtime_details(user_id, inventory_id, snapshot):
    """
    Adds computed runtime details before the item is removed from inventory.

    Important: weapon damage in ROM is calculated by helpers and refine modifiers,
    so raw item columns are not always enough for Auction House details.
    """

    snapshot = dict(snapshot or {})

    try:
        from db import get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id
        weapon_damage = get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id(int(inventory_id))
        if isinstance(weapon_damage, dict) and weapon_damage.get("is_weapon"):
            snapshot["auction_weapon_damage"] = weapon_damage
    except Exception as error:
        snapshot["auction_weapon_damage_error"] = str(error)

    return snapshot

def create_equipment_auction_lot(user_id, inventory_id, price):
    """
    Replaces 8.0.3 equipment listing with snapshot enrichment.

    The item is still moved out of inventory into auction_lots, but before deletion
    we store computed weapon damage / refine-aware details into item_snapshot_json.
    """

    init_auction_house()

    check = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)

    if not check.get("success"):
        return check

    can_create = can_user_create_auction_lot(user_id)
    if not can_create.get("success"):
        return can_create

    price_result = validate_auction_price(price)
    if not price_result.get("success"):
        return price_result

    now = now_iso()
    expires_at = iso_after_days(AUCTION_ACTIVE_DAYS)

    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        check_inside = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)
        if not check_inside.get("success"):
            conn.rollback()
            return check_inside

        snapshot = check_inside["snapshot"]
        snapshot = _auction_enrich_equipment_snapshot_with_runtime_details(user_id, inventory_id, snapshot)
        # Rune/type data is now fully captured before inventory deletion.

        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO auction_lots (
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            item_type,
            item_source,
            item_ref_id,
            item_snapshot_json,
            item_name,
            item_name_norm,
            category,
            rarity,
            level,
            enhancement_level,
            durability_current,
            durability_max,
            quantity,
            price,
            status,
            created_at,
            expires_at,
            updated_at
        ) VALUES (?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            user_id,
            snapshot.get("item_type") or "equipment",
            "inventory",
            int(inventory_id),
            safe_json_dumps(snapshot),
            snapshot["name"],
            snapshot["name"].lower(),
            AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
            snapshot.get("rarity", ""),
            int(snapshot.get("level", 0) or 0),
            int(snapshot.get("refine_level", 0) or 0),
            snapshot.get("durability_current"),
            snapshot.get("durability_max"),
            1,
            price_result["price"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            now,
            expires_at,
            now,
        ))

        lot_id = cursor.lastrowid

        cursor.execute(
            "DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",
            (inventory_id, user_id)
        )

        if cursor.rowcount != 1:
            conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "❌ Не вдалося перенести предмет з інвентаря.",
            }

        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO auction_history (
            lot_id,
            event_type,
            actor_user_id,
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            item_name,
            category,
            quantity,
            price,
            status_before,
            status_after,
            details_json,
            created_at
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            lot_id,
            AUCTION_HISTORY_LISTED,
            user_id,
            user_id,
            snapshot["name"],
            AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
            1,
            price_result["price"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            safe_json_dumps({
                "inventory_id": inventory_id,
                "item_id": snapshot.get("item_id"),
                "runtime_details": "weapon_damage_snapshot_v1",
            }),
            now,
        ))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "success": True,
            "lot_id": lot_id,
            "item_name": snapshot["name"],
            "price": price_result["price"],
            "expires_at": expires_at,
            "message": "✅ Лот виставлено на продаж.",
        }

    except Exception as error:
        try:
            conn.rollback()
        except Exception:
            pass

        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": f"❌ Помилка створення лота: {error}",
        }

def _auction_weapon_hand_line(snapshot):
    name = str(snapshot.get("name") or snapshot.get("raw_name") or "").lower()
    item_type = str(snapshot.get("item_type") or "").lower()

    two_handed_raw = _auction_snapshot_value(snapshot, "two_handed", "is_two_handed", "requires_two_hands", "twohanded")
    hands_raw = _auction_snapshot_value(snapshot, "hands", "weapon_hands", "handedness")

    two_handed = False
    if str(two_handed_raw).lower() in ["1", "true", "yes", "так"]:
        two_handed = True
    if str(hands_raw).lower() in ["2", "two", "two_handed", "2h", "дворучна", "дворучний"]:
        two_handed = True
    if "дворуч" in name:
        two_handed = True

    is_weapon = bool(
        snapshot.get("auction_weapon_damage")
        or item_type in ["weapon", "staff", "wand", "sword", "axe", "mace", "dagger", "bow"]
        or "жезл" in name
        or "посох" in name
        or "меч" in name
        or "сокир" in name
        or "киндж" in name
        or "лук" in name
    )

    if not is_weapon:
        return None

    return "✋ Тип зброї: дворучна" if two_handed else "✋ Тип зброї: одноручна"

            lines.append("ℹ️ Детальні характеристики для цього предмета не знайдені у snapshot.")

        rune_lines = _auction_rune_socket_lines(snapshot)
        if rune_lines:
            lines.append("")
            lines.extend(rune_lines)

        lines.append("")
        lines.append("Перевір характеристики предмета перед тим, як ввести ціну.")

        return {
            "success": True,
            "snapshot": snapshot,
            "text": "\n".join(lines),
        }

    # Stack items: potions/materials.
    snapshot_result = get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction(user_id, inventory_id)
    if not snapshot_result.get("success"):
        return snapshot_result

    snapshot = snapshot_result["snapshot"]

    if _auction_is_success_rune(snapshot):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ 💎 Руну Успіху не можна виставити на Торговий Дім.",
        }

    if not _auction_stack_category_matches(snapshot, category):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Предмет не належить до обраної категорії.",
        }

    quantity = int(snapshot.get("quantity", 0) or 0)

    lines = []
    lines.append("📦 Огляд товару")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(str(snapshot.get("name") or "Предмет"))
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(_auction_inventory_style_type_line(category))
    lines.append(f"📦 У наявності: {quantity}")

    desc_lines = _auction_collect_stack_description_lines(snapshot)
    if desc_lines:
        lines.append("")
        lines.extend(desc_lines)

    lines.append("")
    lines.append("Перевір товар перед тим, як вказати кількість для продажу.")

    return {
        "success": True,
        "snapshot": snapshot,
        "text": "\n".join(lines),
    }

def cancel_active_auction_lot(user_id, lot_id):
    """
    Cancels seller's ACTIVE lot and returns item to inventory.

    Status: ACTIVE -> EXPIRED_CLAIMED.
    This mirrors manual cancel in the spec: the seller receives the item back immediately.
    """
    init_auction_house()
    user_id = int(user_id)
    lot_id = int(lot_id)

    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM auction_lots WHERE id=? AND seller_user_id=?", (lot_id, user_id))
        lot = cursor.fetchone()

        if not lot:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Лот не знайдено."}

        if lot["status"] != AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "⚠️ Зняти можна тільки активний лот."}

        snapshot = safe_json_loads(lot["item_snapshot_json"])
        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)

        # Return item first; this checks/uses inventory space.
        returned_inventory_id = _auction_insert_inventory_from_snapshot(user_id, snapshot, quantity=quantity)

        now = now_iso()
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE auction_lots
        SET status=?,
            claimed_at=?,
            updated_at=?
        WHERE id=? AND seller_user_id=? AND status=?
        """, (
            AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_CLAIMED,
            now,
            now,
            lot_id,
            user_id,
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        ))

        if cursor.rowcount != 1:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "⚠️ Лот уже недоступний."}

        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO auction_history (
            lot_id,
            event_type,
            actor_user_id,
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            item_name,
            category,
            quantity,
            price,
            status_before,
            status_after,
            details_json,
            created_at
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            lot_id,
            AUCTION_HISTORY_CANCELLED,
            user_id,
            user_id,
            lot["item_name"],
            lot["category"],
            quantity,
            lot["price"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_CLAIMED,
            safe_json_dumps({"returned_inventory_id": returned_inventory_id}),
            now,
        ))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": "✅ Лот знято з продажу.",
            "lot_id": lot_id,
            "item_name": lot["item_name"],
            "quantity": quantity,
            "inventory_id": returned_inventory_id,
        }

    except Exception as error:
        try:
            conn.rollback()
        except Exception:
            pass
        return {"success": False, "message": f"❌ Помилка зняття лота: {error}"}

def buy_auction_lot_v2(buyer_user_id, lot_id):
    """
    Transactional auction purchase.

    ACTIVE -> SOLD_UNCLAIMED.
    Buyer receives item immediately.
    Seller claims gold later in completed sales.
    """
    init_auction_house()
    update_expired_auction_lots()

    buyer_user_id = int(buyer_user_id)
    lot_id = int(lot_id)

    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM auction_lots WHERE id=?", (lot_id,))
        lot = cursor.fetchone()

        if not lot:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "❌ Лот не знайдено."}

        if lot["status"] != AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "⚠️ Лот уже недоступний."}

        seller_user_id = int(lot["seller_user_id"] or 0)
        if seller_user_id == buyer_user_id:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "⚠️ Не можна купити власний лот."}

        price = auction_price_to_decimal(lot["price"])
        buyer_gold = _auction_get_user_gold(buyer_user_id)

        if buyer_gold < price:
            conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": (
                    "❌ Недостатньо золота.\n\n"
                    f"💰 Потрібно: {decimal_to_price_text(price)}\n"
                    f"💰 У тебе: {decimal_to_price_text(buyer_gold)}"
                )
            }

        snapshot = safe_json_loads(lot["item_snapshot_json"])
        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)

        inventory_id = _auction_insert_inventory_from_snapshot(
            buyer_user_id,
            snapshot,
            quantity=quantity,
        )

        _auction_set_user_gold(buyer_user_id, buyer_gold - price)

        now = now_iso()
        delete_after = _auction_plus_days_iso_v2(now, AUCTION_UNCLAIMED_RETENTION_DAYS_V2)

        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE auction_lots
        SET status=?,
            buyer_user_id=?,
            sold_at=?,
            delete_after=?,
            updated_at=?
        WHERE id=? AND status=?
        """, (
            AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED,
            buyer_user_id,
            now,
            delete_after,
            now,
            lot_id,
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        ))

        if cursor.rowcount != 1:
            conn.rollback()
            return {"success": False, "message": "⚠️ Лот уже куплений іншим гравцем."}

        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO auction_history (
            lot_id,
            event_type,
            actor_user_id,
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            item_name,
            category,
            quantity,
            price,
            status_before,
            status_after,
            details_json,
            created_at
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            lot_id,
            AUCTION_HISTORY_SOLD,
            buyer_user_id,
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            lot["item_name"],
            lot["category"],
            quantity,
            lot["price"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED,
            safe_json_dumps({"buyer_inventory_id": inventory_id}),
            now,
        ))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": "✅ Покупку завершено!",
            "lot_id": lot_id,
            "item_name": lot["item_name"],
            "quantity": quantity,
            "price": lot["price"],
            "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        }

    except Exception as error:
        try:
            conn.rollback()
        except Exception:
            pass
        return {"success": False, "message": f"❌ Помилка покупки: {error}"}

def get_user_auction_history(user_id, mode="all", limit=8, offset=0):
    """
    Returns user's auction history using sold lots:
    - mode='buy'  -> lots bought by user
    - mode='sell' -> lots sold by user
    - mode='all'  -> both bought and sold
    """

    init_auction_house()

    user_id = int(user_id)
    mode = str(mode or "all")

    try:
        limit = int(limit)
    except Exception:
        limit = 8
    try:

    except Exception:
        offset = 0

    limit = max(1, min(50, limit))
    offset = max(0, offset)
    if offset >= AUCTION_USER_HISTORY_MAX_RECORDS:
        return []
    limit = min(limit, AUCTION_USER_HISTORY_MAX_RECORDS - offset)

    sold_statuses = _auction_sold_statuses_v1()
    params = list(sold_statuses)

    status_filter = "status IN (?, ?)"

    if mode == "buy":
        actor_filter = "buyer_user_id=?"
        params.append(user_id)
    elif mode == "sell":
        actor_filter = "seller_user_id=?"
        params.append(user_id)
    else:

    sql = f"""
    SELECT *
    FROM auction_lots
    WHERE {status_filter}
      AND {actor_filter}
    ORDER BY COALESCE({date_col}, created_at) DESC, id DESC
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
    """

    cursor.execute(sql, tuple(params))
    return cursor.fetchall()

def update_expired_auction_lots(now_iso=None):
    """
    Повний cleanup Торгового Дому.

    Правила:
    - ACTIVE із expires_at <= now -> EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED;
    - EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED із delete_after <= now -> DELETED;
    - SOLD_UNCLAIMED із delete_after <= now -> DELETED.

    SOLD_CLAIMED / EXPIRED_CLAIMED не видаляються цим cleanup-ом, бо це історія.
    """

    init_auction_house()

    from datetime import datetime

    now_iso = now_iso or _auction_now_iso_v2()
    now_dt = _auction_parse_dt_v2(now_iso) or datetime.now()

    result = {
        "success": True,
        "now": now_iso,
        "expired_active": 0,
        "deleted_expired_unclaimed": 0,
        "deleted_sold_unclaimed": 0,
        "fixed_missing_delete_after": 0,
    }

    has_delete_after = _auction_column_exists_v2("auction_lots", "delete_after")
    has_expires_at = _auction_column_exists_v2("auction_lots", "expires_at")
    has_updated_at = _auction_column_exists_v2("auction_lots", "updated_at")

    if not has_expires_at:
        return result

    # 1. ACTIVE -> EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT id, expires_at, delete_after
    FROM auction_lots
    WHERE status=?
    """, (AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE_V2,))
    active_rows = cursor.fetchall()

    for row in active_rows:
        expires_dt = _auction_parse_dt_v2(row["expires_at"])
        if not expires_dt or expires_dt > now_dt:
            continue

        delete_after = row["delete_after"] if has_delete_after else None
        if not delete_after:
            delete_after = _auction_plus_days_iso_v2(now_iso, AUCTION_UNCLAIMED_RETENTION_DAYS_V2)

        if has_delete_after and has_updated_at:
            cursor.execute("""
            UPDATE auction_lots
            SET status=?, delete_after=?, updated_at=?
            WHERE id=? AND status=?
            """, (
                AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED_V2,
                delete_after,
                now_iso,
                row["id"],
                AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE_V2,
            ))
        elif has_delete_after:
            cursor.execute("""
            UPDATE auction_lots
            SET status=?, delete_after=?
            WHERE id=? AND status=?
            """, (
                AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED_V2,
                delete_after,
                row["id"],
                AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE_V2,
            ))
        else:
            cursor.execute("""
            UPDATE auction_lots
            SET status=?
            WHERE id=? AND status=?
            """, (
                AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED_V2,
                row["id"],
                AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE_V2,
            ))

        if cursor.rowcount:
            result["expired_active"] += 1

    # 2. Fix missing delete_after for unclaimed statuses.
    if has_delete_after:
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT id, status, sold_at, expires_at, created_at, delete_after
        FROM auction_lots
        WHERE status IN (?, ?)
          AND (delete_after IS NULL OR delete_after='')
        """, (
            AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED_V2,
            AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED_V2,
        ))
        missing_rows = cursor.fetchall()

        for row in missing_rows:
            base_date = row["sold_at"] or row["expires_at"] or row["created_at"] or now_iso
            delete_after = _auction_plus_days_iso_v2(base_date, AUCTION_UNCLAIMED_RETENTION_DAYS_V2)
            cursor.execute("""
            UPDATE auction_lots
            SET delete_after=?
            WHERE id=?
            """, (delete_after, row["id"]))
            if cursor.rowcount:
                result["fixed_missing_delete_after"] += 1

    # 3. EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED -> DELETED after retention.
    if has_delete_after:
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT id, delete_after
        FROM auction_lots
        WHERE status=?
          AND delete_after IS NOT NULL
          AND delete_after<>''
        """, (AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED_V2,))
        expired_unclaimed_rows = cursor.fetchall()

        for row in expired_unclaimed_rows:
            delete_dt = _auction_parse_dt_v2(row["delete_after"])
            if not delete_dt or delete_dt > now_dt:
                continue

            if has_updated_at:
                cursor.execute("""
                UPDATE auction_lots
                SET status=?, updated_at=?
                WHERE id=? AND status=?
                """, (
                    AUCTION_STATUS_DELETED_V2,
                    now_iso,
                    row["id"],
                    AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED_V2,
                ))
            else:
                cursor.execute("""
                UPDATE auction_lots
                SET status=?
                WHERE id=? AND status=?
                """, (
                    AUCTION_STATUS_DELETED_V2,
                    row["id"],
                    AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED_V2,
                ))

            if cursor.rowcount:
                result["deleted_expired_unclaimed"] += 1

        # 4. SOLD_UNCLAIMED -> DELETED after retention.
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT id, delete_after
        FROM auction_lots
        WHERE status=?
          AND delete_after IS NOT NULL
          AND delete_after<>''
        """, (AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED_V2,))
        sold_unclaimed_rows = cursor.fetchall()

        for row in sold_unclaimed_rows:
            delete_dt = _auction_parse_dt_v2(row["delete_after"])
            if not delete_dt or delete_dt > now_dt:
                continue

            if has_updated_at:
                cursor.execute("""
                UPDATE auction_lots
                SET status=?, updated_at=?
                WHERE id=? AND status=?
                """, (
                    AUCTION_STATUS_DELETED_V2,
                    now_iso,
                    row["id"],
                    AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED_V2,
                ))
            else:
                cursor.execute("""
                UPDATE auction_lots
                SET status=?
                WHERE id=? AND status=?
                """, (
                    AUCTION_STATUS_DELETED_V2,
                    row["id"],
                    AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED_V2,
                ))

            if cursor.rowcount:
                result["deleted_sold_unclaimed"] += 1

    conn.commit()
    return result

def get_auction_diagnostics_report():
    """
    Conservative diagnostics for Auction House.
    Does not mutate state except running regular expiration cleanup.
    """

    init_auction_house()

    try:
        update_expired_auction_lots()
    except Exception:
        pass

    statuses = _auction_diag_statuses_v1()
    min_price, max_price = _auction_diag_price_limits_v1()

    result = {
        "success": True,
        "status_counts": {},
        "total_lots": 0,
        "bad_price_lots": [],
        "missing_snapshot_lots": [],
        "active_missing_expires_at": [],
        "unclaimed_missing_delete_after": [],
        "sold_unclaimed_without_buyer": [],
        "active_lots_by_seller": [],
        "max_active_lots_per_seller": 20,
        "tables_ok": True,
        "missing_tables": [],
    }

    required_tables = ["auction_lots", "auction_history"]
    for table_name in required_tables:
        if not _auction_diag_table_exists_v1(table_name):
            result["tables_ok"] = False
            result["missing_tables"].append(table_name)

    if not result["tables_ok"]:
        return result

    cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM auction_lots")
    row = cursor.fetchone()
    result["total_lots"] = int(row["count"] or 0) if row else 0

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM auction_lots
    GROUP BY status
    ORDER BY status
    """)
    for row in cursor.fetchall():
        result["status_counts"][row["status"]] = int(row["count"] or 0)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT id, seller_user_id, item_name, price, status, item_snapshot_json, expires_at, delete_after, buyer_user_id
    FROM auction_lots
    ORDER BY id DESC
    """)
    rows = cursor.fetchall()

    for row in rows:
        lot_id = row["id"]
        status = row["status"]
        price = _auction_diag_parse_decimal_v1(row["price"])

        if price is None or price < min_price or price > max_price:
            result["bad_price_lots"].append(lot_id)

        if not str(row["item_snapshot_json"] or "").strip():
            result["missing_snapshot_lots"].append(lot_id)

        if status == statuses["ACTIVE"] and not str(row["expires_at"] or "").strip():
            result["active_missing_expires_at"].append(lot_id)

        if status in (statuses["SOLD_UNCLAIMED"], statuses["EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED"]):
            if not str(row["delete_after"] or "").strip():
                result["unclaimed_missing_delete_after"].append(lot_id)

        if status == statuses["SOLD_UNCLAIMED"] and not row["buyer_user_id"]:
            result["sold_unclaimed_without_buyer"].append(lot_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT seller_user_id, COUNT(*) AS active_count
    FROM auction_lots
    WHERE status=?
    GROUP BY seller_user_id
    ORDER BY active_count DESC
    """, (statuses["ACTIVE"],))
    result["active_lots_by_seller"] = [
        {
            "seller_user_id": row["seller_user_id"],
            "active_count": int(row["active_count"] or 0),
        }
        for row in cursor.fetchall()
    ]

    return result
